prompt.en: At a public-service site, a scanner hears a phantom tone only when a paging transmitter and a data link are both active. Moving the scanner and adding an input filter reduce the symptom. What did those tests point toward?

text.en: Mixing in a non-linear input path before the wanted channel was selected.
A keying waveform fault, because two voice or data transmitters always create Morse clicks.
A telephone audio pickup path, because an input filter at the scanner fixed telephone wiring.
A transmitter low-pass filter failure, because receiver location changes prove harmonic radiation.

explanation.en: The symptom needs two strong sources and improves when less off-channel energy reaches the scanner input. That points to intermodulation or overload in a non-linear input path, not an automatic transmitter repair.

prompt.en: Powered speakers reproduce muffled SSB audio during nearby transmissions. The volume control barely changes the unwanted sound, and shortening the audio lead helps. Which path does that support?

text.en: RF pickup and audio rectification in the speaker lead or input circuit.
A distant receiver hearing key clicks from sharp CW keying.
A harmonic relationship that must affect only one television channel.
A solved problem, because volume controls always remove rectified RF.

explanation.en: Lead length, weak volume-control effect, and demodulated speech in an audio device fit audio rectification. Short leads, routing changes, and ferrites near the affected device test that path.

prompt.en: A receiver loses weak signals across several tuned frequencies whenever a nearby clean transmitter runs. The unwanted frequency is outside the desired band. What first cure best matches the diagnosis?

text.en: Place a suitable filter before the receiver front end so the strong unwanted signal is reduced before overload.
Add only an audio tone control after detection, because overload starts in the speaker.
Open the transmitter first, because a clean off-channel signal proves spurious emissions.
Use an RF attenuator as the equal first choice, with no cost to wanted weak signals.

explanation.en: The symptom fits receiver front-end overload or desensitization. The filter belongs before the overloaded stage; attenuation can be a fallback, but it also weakens wanted signals.
